text:
maria: Heads up — Windows installer created a Start Menu shortcut that launches the wrong EXE path for my user, and the auth flow keeps failing when I open redwoodctl from Start.

simon: Ugh. Which installer did you run and can you paste `where redwoodctl` + `Get-Command redwoodctl` output?

maria: Using redwoodctl-1.4.2-x64.msi from releases. Output:
```
C:\Program Files\Redwood\redwoodctl.exe
C:\Users\Maria AppData\Local\Programs\Redwood\redwoodctl.exe
```
Start Menu shortcut target points to the second path (note the space in my username), and launching it gives: 
```
error: failed to exec credential helper: The system cannot find the path specified.
spawn E2BIG
```

aj: Looks like the installer wrote two install locations and the Start Menu shortcut resolved to the per-user path incorrectly. Quick workaround: edit the shortcut target to "C:\Program Files\Redwood\redwoodctl.exe" (right-click -> Properties) or delete shortcut and run `powershell -Command New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Redwood.lnk" -Target 'C:\Program Files\Redwood\redwoodctl.exe'` if you want programmatic fix. Also `redwoodctl login --no-browser` should let you finish device flow if Start Menu shortcut misbehaves.

simon: Can you try `redwoodctl --version` from an elevated prompt and run `msiexec /x` with the msilog turned on so we get the installer log? We need the MSI component that writes Start Menu links.

maria: `redwoodctl --version` prints `redwoodctl 1.4.2`. I'll run: `msiexec /i redwoodctl-1.4.2-x64.msi /L*V C:\temp\redwood-installer.log` and drop the log here.

aj: Thanks — filing a bug against the Windows MSI authoring and Start Menu shortcut logic. Could be the InstallScope/user detection. For immediate DX: `setx REDWOODCTL_PROFILE localtest` then open a new cmd and run `redwoodctl local serve` as a fallback for local testing.

maria: Workaround worked — `login --no-browser` + edited shortcut fixed the auth loop. Attaching repro steps to the bug. :thumbsup: 

devex-bot: FYI we added a troubleshooting doc: https://internal.redwood/devex/cli/windows-shortcut-fix with the CLI workarounds and `msiexec` logging steps.

maria: Awesome, thanks all. Logging the bug and leaving repro notes. :raised_hands:
